notes: Breadboard rows f-j (the half with row labels j..f at the top of the picture) are bank 'b' in the catalogue naming.

Green wire goes from MKR pin 2 to column 3 (row g); resistor spans column 3 to column 6 (row h); LED anode (bent, longer leg) is in column 6 and cathode in column 8 (row i); black wire links GND to column 8 (row h).
Exact rows within a column strip are approximate from the image but do not change connectivity.
The schematic shows a 220 ohm resistor from pin 2 to the LED anode and the LED cathode to GND, matching the breadboard picture.
The board is powered/programmed over USB; no USB cable or computer is shown in the circuit images so none is added.
The analog pin A1 is read in software but nothing is connected to it.
